purpose: Does retrieval from a question-based legal corpus (arm K) improve Qwen3.5-9B on Legal MC over the frozen closed-book prompt (arm B), and how much of the MC-100 oracle gain (arm O) does it keep?

pool.description: the 134 Legal MC items of the wide phase, each answered by B on two draws: the pool of MC-100

mc100.use: its frozen strata, support labels and oracle provisions (arm O and the mechanism analysis) and its owner review (the gold check), each checked against the SHA-256 that MC-100 registered

corpus.chosen_by: four Claude agents, about 34 items each in item-id order, from the question stems only: no options, no gold, no strata, no MC-100 file

roles.topical: up to 3 per item: documents that govern the question's subject, preferring the version in force
roles.predecessor: for a topical document, the instrument it replaced or amends, when the site carries it
roles.distractor: up to 5 per batch: documents of the same fields that govern other matters

corpus.merge: by URL, one entry per page; on a clash topical wins over predecessor, which wins over distractor; a consolidated-text number (VBHN) printed on pages of different years is qualified by the year its page title prints, and any other number on two pages fails the merge
corpus.frozen_before: the corpus build and any retrieval query
corpus.reader: MC-100's reader (top-level article elements; a page breaking off inside its last article element keeps the articles closed before it), plus: a heading with a footnote marker (Điều 15[15].) heads Điều 15; a document with a `part` also yields every article of the text attached under that heading line, each running to the next article heading; a chapter, section or upper-case annex heading ends an article, and the attached text ends at a signature or recipients line, at the site's own blocks that follow every document (related documents, validity, document data, notices) or at a repeated article number
corpus.unit: an article; an article over unit_max_chars characters is split into consecutive parts at line boundaries, each part after the first opening with the article's heading line
corpus.leak_check: a question stem copied verbatim, or an answer-key line, in a unit fails the build; options copied verbatim are counted only
corpus.omitted: a document whose page cannot be fetched or yields no article is listed with its reason, never filled in by hand

retrieval.pause_before_registration: if hit@2 against the MC-100 oracle articles is below 0.5 on its items with provisions, pause and report to the owner

arms.B: the item's frozen main-v1 MC prompt
arms.K: the campaign evidence block with the item's top-2 units, then the frozen prompt
arms.O: the campaign evidence block with the item's MC-100 oracle provisions, then the frozen prompt; items with provisions only

analysis.item_score: mean correctness of an arm over its two draws
analysis.primary: always-K against always-B over the 134 items: mean per-item difference

reading_rule.rule: K becomes the Legal MC arm of the router when its mean exceeds B's and the two-sided sign-flip p-value is below alpha; otherwise always-B stays the Legal MC route

analysis.descriptive: per MC-100 stratum on supports_gold items: K against B, K against O, and in stratum wrong the share of O's gain that K keeps; the items outside MC-100: K against B; hit@1, hit@2 and hit@3 against the MC-100 oracle articles, and K's and O's accuracy on hit and miss items; the overlap of corpus and oracle documents; each arm's options on contradicts_gold items (gold, owner, other); clear rescues and regressions on the pool; the share answering A; mean tokens per arm; evidence length
